subject: Pollination Contract Request for St. Agnes Pollination
body_text:
Hi there, 

I hope this message finds you well! We are looking to finalize our pollination contract for the orchard almond segment this year. We'd like to order 40 hives to cover our 20-acre block on Oak Lane, similar to last year's arrangement. The target delivery date is set for March 10, aligning with the blueberry bloom.

Please let me know if you can accommodate a split delivery, as we might need some hives earlier for a staggered pollination schedule. Looking forward to your prompt response so we can get this sorted out!

Best,  
Courtney Gonzalez

subject: Pollination Services and Hive Contracts for 2024
body_text:
Hello Meridian Apiaries Team,  

I hope this message finds you well! I’m reaching out to discuss our upcoming pollination needs for Mountain Valley Farms across our various sites in Oregon. For our peach and cherry orchards, we’re looking at needing approximately 30 hives each for the weeks of March 25 through April 15.  

Additionally, we plan to expand our apple orchard this year, which will require an extra 40 hives from May 1 to June 15. Could you let me know if you can accommodate this schedule? Also, I’d like to discuss restructuring our contract to cover these changes and potentially lock in some hives for our upcoming blueberry season in July.  

Thanks for your help! I appreciate your prompt response as we begin planning.  

Best,  
Charles Lee
